name: forecast-03
description: Month to date, projected to the end of the month at the daily run-rate, with what is needed per day to hit the target.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { ForecastLegend, ForecastStatusLabel, ProjectionBar, getProjectionStatus, getRunRate, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/forecast' import { KPIValue } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/kpi' import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatPercent, } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' interface Forecast3Props { /** Leave out to show the empty state. */ current?: number description: string elapsed: number formatter?: (value: number) => string status?: BlockStatus target: number title: string total: number } const exampleProps: Forecast3Props = { current: 38_420, description: 'Month to date through Sep 25, projected at the daily run-rate.', elapsed: 25, formatter: (value) => formatCurrency(value), target: 48_000, title: 'September revenue', total: 30, } const Forecast3 = (props: Forecast3Props) => { const { current = 0, description, elapsed, formatter = (value) => formatNumber(value, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }), status: blockStatus, target, title, total, } = props const state = getBlockState(blockStatus, props.current) const { projected, rate, remaining, required } = getRunRate({ current, elapsed, target, total, }) const status = current >= target ? 'reached' : getProjectionStatus(projected, target) const gap = projected - target const share = formatPercent(target > 0 ? projected / target : 0, { maximumFractionDigits: 0, }) return (

{title}

{description}

So far, day {elapsed} of {total}
{state !== 'empty' && state !== 'error' && (
Projected
{share} of {formatter(target)}
)}

{status === 'reached' ? `Target met with ${remaining} ${remaining === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'} to go, at ${formatter(rate)} a day.` : `At ${formatter(rate)} a day the month ends ${formatter(Math.abs(gap))} ${gap >= 0 ? 'over' : 'short'}.`} {status !== 'reached' && required !== null && required > 0 && ( {` Hitting the target takes ${formatter(required)} a day for the last ${remaining} ${remaining === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'}.`} )}

) } export { Forecast3, exampleProps as forecast3ExampleProps, type Forecast3Props }
